Bubble1.Text: Welcome to the testing grounds. You wake up with 100 Gold and an Old Key in your inventory display.

Bubble2.Text: Hey there! I am a mysterious companion. Right now, you haven't unlocked my identity, so you should see my HiddenImage and my name masked as '???'!

Choice2.Text: Unlock the nearby chest using your Old Key

Bubble1.Text: You slide 50 Gold to the stranger. Your top-right inventory display should drop to 50 Gold instantly.

Bubble2.Text: Wow, thank you! My name is actually Bob! The engine has just set the 'StrangerRevealed' flag. On the next screen, my standard profile image and real name will unlock!

Choice1.Text: Talk to Bob now that he trusts you

Bubble1.Text: Look at that! Because the 'StrangerRevealed' flag is true, you can now see my actual portrait and my name says 'MysteriousStranger' instead of question marks!

Choice1.Text: Head towards the final exit gate

Bubble1.Text: You insert the Old Key into the chest. It clicks open smoothly.

Bubble2.Text: Inside you find a legendary item: the StarMedallion! Your Old Key is removed from your pouch.

Choice1.Text: Take the medallion and move forward

Bubble1.Text: You stand before the grand exit archway of the test script matrix.

Choice1.Text: Step through to trigger the standard game-ending routine
